# LC Insight

> English-language crypto news and on-chain analysis. Every figure links to a primary source (companies, regulators, courts, filings, blockchains, CoinGecko/CoinMarketCap) and DeepSea (desea.io) on-chain data. Facts and LC Insight's own analysis are kept in separate, labeled sections.

Editorial standards: https://lcinsight.net/about.html
RSS: https://lcinsight.net/feed.xml
Sitemap: https://lcinsight.net/sitemap.xml
